name: A/B Experiment on Single-Page Checkout Conversion
task_description: Design and execute an A/B growth experiment testing a single-page checkout variant against multi-step checkout, defining telemetry tracking schemas and statistical evaluation criteria.
invariants: Experiment must declare explicit null hypothesis and primary metric prior to code edits
Telemetry event names and schemas must adhere to canonical tracking format
Feature flag must fail-open to default control flow in case of configuration errors
